subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats support automatic per-sender dynamic agents or subagents, and if so should the owner model extend groupSessionScope, Dynamic Agent Creation, or thread-bound subagent bindings?
rationale: The requested behavior is not a missing one-line feature; it chooses a persistent identity, memory, permissions, routing, and lifecycle model that can cross plugin SDK and security boundaries.

options.title: Narrow To Session Isolation And API Design
options.body: Treat #40194 and groupSessionScope as the near-term path, then design a Feishu-owned group dynamic-agent API before implementation.

options.title: Implement Plugin-Owned Group Dynamic Agents
options.body: Add explicit opt-in Feishu group dynamic-agent creation with lifecycle caps, security review, migrations, docs, and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Do Not Add Group Agent Hierarchy
options.body: Document existing sender scopes, bindings, and DM dynamic agents as the supported alternatives and close the broad orchestrator request.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Session Isolation And API Design
recommendation.body: Treat #40194 and groupSessionScope as the near-term path, then design a Feishu-owned group dynamic-agent API before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and docs identify @m1heng as the Feishu/Lark plugin maintainer signal, making them the best first decision owner for this channel-specific product/API direction.
